transcript.answer: Pull request #2823 in re-cinq/lore, titled "Context evals: run from a developer machine, never on a schedule". It was merged on 2026-10-19 by gedaiu. It deleted the `.github/workflows/context-evals.yml` workflow, which had run the evals nightly at 03:17 UTC. The evals are now run by hand with `scripts/context-evals/run.mjs`. The PR gives two reasons: the evals are experiments a person runs and writes up, and the unattended run had failed three nights in a row (10-17, 10-18, 10-19).
